question: snow depth and water equivalent
needed_measurement: snow pillow or ultrasonic depth sensor plus manual density cores, on at least one shaded and one sunny plot in the same elevation band
why_satellite_cannot: optical imagery sees the surface, not the depth below it

question: real (not clear-sky) irradiance
needed_measurement: two pyranometers on contrasting aspects inside the footprint
why_satellite_cannot: the model here is clear-sky by construction; cloud attenuation is unmeasured

question: the December sun figure for one specific site
needed_measurement: a horizon survey from the site, or a short-baseline photogrammetric or lidar DEM
why_satellite_cannot: the three open DEMs disagree by 50-66 % at the 95th percentile on exactly this quantity (section 6)

question: snowmaking windows
needed_measurement: wet-bulb temperature at the gun line, wind speed and direction, water yield and temperature, equipment curves
why_satellite_cannot: none of these quantities is observed from orbit

question: season opening date
needed_measurement: a continuous depth record against an operating threshold, over several seasons
why_satellite_cannot: a 5-day revisit with cloud gaps cannot resolve a threshold crossing to the day

question: avalanche terrain classification
needed_measurement: snowpack profiles, wind transport and loading patterns, mapped start and runout zones, local forecaster judgement
why_satellite_cannot: slope angle is geometry; release depends on the snowpack

question: mid-winter snow statistics on shaded ground
needed_measurement: ground observation, or Sentinel-1 SAR wet-snow retrieval to see through cloud
why_satellite_cannot: in the thinnest month only 43 % of this window has four clear observations, and that subset is biased +285 kWh/m² sunnier (section 4)

question: where the beginner terrain can physically go
needed_measurement: a design-grade survey of the gentle benches and of what can be linked by lift
why_satellite_cannot: a 30 m DEM resolves that the gentle ground arrives in 67 pieces, not whether two of them can be joined
